description: Keeps a font for this account (a TTF, OTF, WOFF or WOFF2 link or file, or an open catalog family) after checking its license allows embedding; write_graphic then draws it by family. Cost: Free.

data.description: Or the font file itself, base64.

family.description: Or a family from the open font catalog (Google Fonts, OFL), such as "Fraunces".

name.description: A file name to keep it under.

url.description: A public https link to the font file (TTF, OTF, WOFF, WOFF2).

weight.description: With family: 100 to 900 (400 when left out).

name: import_font

outputSchema.description: Clypmint import_font result. Error results carry error; successful requests expose the identifiers and state available for the next step. Signed media stays in private metadata.

title: Import a font
